source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 10 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.241

dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: every public item whose record mentions this DOI, Hausdorff dimension of limit sets, Anosov or projective Anosov representations, convex or divisible convex domains, supporting hyperplanes and Lipschitz or spacelike submanifolds, plus the retired-claims list and the preparation worklist, and the same-source counted unit. No global novelty claim.
compared: public 2204 (same source, counted unit): Theorem 3.1 with label 'th - lower bound', statement source lines 1100-1103 and proof at 1258-1266. It is the lower bound DimH(Lambda_Gamma) >= delta_{1,2}(Gamma) for a projective Anosov subgroup, proved from Hilbert cross ratios and a primal-dual boundary estimate. This task's statement is about a single strictly convex C^1 domain, mentions no group and no critical exponent, and its counted spans (1008-1012, 1016-1061) and context spans (1003-1005, 1014) are disjoint from all spans of 2204.

public 2311 'Falconer-Lyapunov dimension variational principle for faithful Zariski-dense partially Anosov representations' (doi:10.5802/jep.285): a variational principle for a dimension of limit sets of Anosov representations. It concerns a group representation and a Falconer-Lyapunov dimension, not the graph of the duality homeomorphism of one convex domain.

public 1921 'Strong Markov coding for fixed-point-free Holder metric Anosov flows' (doi:10.5802/jep.115): symbolic coding of Anosov flows; no projective convexity and no Hausdorff dimension of a symmetric boundary.
public 125427 'Hausdorff dimension in quasiregular dynamics' (arxiv:2205.03626v1, label lemma3): a Hausdorff-dimension estimate in quasiregular dynamics, a different branch with different objects.

public 173246 'Convex cocompact groups in real hyperbolic spaces with limit set a Pontryagin sphere' (arxiv:2502.09470v3, label lem:menger_vertex): a combinatorial lemma about limit sets of convex cocompact groups; not about C^1 convex domains or duality graphs.

public 179569, 183376, 194755 (spacelike submanifolds in semi-Riemannian and Lorentzian settings, including retired item 183513): the word spacelike refers to submanifolds of a pseudo-Riemannian ambient space with an induced metric. Here the symmetric form <(u,alpha),(v,beta)> = alpha(v) + beta(u) is a duality pairing on V x V* used only to certify a Lipschitz graph, with no ambient Lorentzian geometry.
public 160123, 147140, 156794 (Hausdorff dimension in smooth dynamics): dimension computations for dynamical systems, with no projective domain and no symmetric boundary.
